data.notes: November 2026 already has a confirmed run of arena, Wiltern, and West Hollywood legacy-rock/metal dates, while most LA club residencies and festival-style lineups have not yet been announced.

events.title: Marilyn Manson: Live in Los Angeles
events.summary: Marilyn Manson headlines The Wiltern on Sunday, November 1, 2026. The Ticketmaster listing confirms the Los Angeles venue and 7:00 PM event time.

events.title: The Limiñanas
events.summary: French psych-garage act The Limiñanas play Teragram Ballroom on Monday, November 2, 2026. Ticketmaster lists Native Sun in the event lineup.

events.title: Bad Gyal - Más Cara World Tour 2026
events.summary: Bad Gyal brings the Más Cara World Tour to The Wiltern on Friday, November 6, 2026. The confirmed Los Angeles date is part of her U.S. run for the tour.

events.title: Eros Ramazzotti - Una Historia Importante
events.summary: Italian pop star Eros Ramazzotti performs at YouTube Theater in nearby Inglewood on Saturday, November 7, 2026. Live Nation confirms the Una Historia Importante date at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Sabaton: Legends on Tour
events.summary: Swedish metal band Sabaton brings Legends on Tour to Hollywood Palladium on Thursday, November 12, 2026. Live Nation lists Pop Evil and Wings of Steel on the lineup.

events.title: Ólafur Arnalds
events.summary: Icelandic composer and electronic/classical artist Ólafur Arnalds performs at The Wiltern on Friday, November 13, 2026. The Ticketmaster listing confirms the date, venue, and 7:00 PM time.

events.title: L7: The Last Hurrah Tour 2026
events.summary: LA-founded alternative rock band L7 plays The Wiltern on Saturday, November 14, 2026 as part of The Last Hurrah Tour 2026. Live Nation confirms the date and venue.

events.title: The Damned - Final Damnation 50
events.summary: Punk pioneers The Damned bring their Final Damnation 50 show to The Wiltern on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. Ticketmaster lists Flamin' Groovies and The Courettes as support.

events.title: Three Days Grace - Alienation Tour
events.summary: Three Days Grace closes the U.S. leg of the Alienation Tour at Intuit Dome in nearby Inglewood on Sunday, November 22, 2026. Live Nation lists I Prevail and The Funeral Portrait on the bill.

events.title: The Untouchables
events.summary: Los Angeles ska/mod veterans The Untouchables play Whisky A Go Go in West Hollywood on Friday, November 27, 2026. The venue’s official calendar confirms the all-ages show and 6:00 PM doors.

events.title: Fear Factory Performing Demanufacture in Its Entirety
events.summary: Industrial-metal band Fear Factory performs Demanufacture in full at Whisky A Go Go on Saturday, November 28, 2026. The venue calendar lists Darkest Hour, Brotality, Stepa, and Of The Betrayer on the bill.
